summary: @or-sdk/flow-templates preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script that runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads a per-platform Bun runtime zip from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...`, extracts and chmods it executable, and then invokes the freshly downloaded Bun binary against the sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated bundle using a rotated string-array (`function WV8StW(MmgoCP,...) {... MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())... }`), a multi-hundred-entry constant array, and randomized `_0xXXXX`-style identifiers; `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with the same scheme. The advertised purpose of the package is a flow-templates SDK, which does not require an alternate JavaScript runtime or an opaque install-time bundle named `math_init.js`. The alternate-runtime is used specifically to execute an opaque sibling script at install time, bypassing Node-based inspection, with no hash or signature verification of either the Bun binary or the payload. Installing this package causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code inside `math_init.js` to execute automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
